messages:
pagerduty: PD-4521 HIGH - service=model-catalog - symptom=tokenizer-mismatch after catalog publish in eu-region. page triggered by error-rate > 5% for /v1/generate. runbook: https://go/runbooks/model-catalog-tokenizer (auto-page)
incident-bot: Incident created and assigned to rotation. Please acknowledge in channel. Suggested play: rollback catalog default revision OR route traffic to fallback variant. See TL;DR in runbook.

Emma Chen: ack — taking this. I'm on-call. :hand:

Jordan Patel: noted — seeing 502/400s and tokenizer errors in logs: "tokenizer mismatch: expected byte-level-bpe, got gpt2" for several customer requests originating from dedicated-eu-1. Sample trace IDs: trace-8a3f, trace-8a7b. Customer impact: ACME (prod) and BetaCorp (staging) reported failures.

Emma Chen: cool. can someone confirm which catalog revision was promoted? I don't see the new tests in CI.

Sahil Rao: I can take rollback. Looks like catalog.defaultRevision was set to rev-2024-06-12-hf in last deploy at 1955550000. prev stable is rev-2024-05-31. Runbook rollback command below (internal API):

```
# update catalog default revision
curl -X PATCH "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/catalog/default" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"defaultRevision":"rev-2024-05-31"}'

# verify
curl "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/catalog/default" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

Marta Gomez: also recommend routing a short-term fallback to reduce blast radius — route 100% traffic for eu to `rwd-small:rev-2024-05-31` while rollback proceeds. I'll apply route change now.

deploy-bot: routing-change: applied route override for cluster=dedicated-eu-1 -> model=rwd-small:rev-2024-05-31 (applied by Marta Gomez).

Emma Chen: Sahil, go ahead with the PATCH and post the command output. I'll monitor customer-facing metrics.

Sahil Rao: executing rollback now. output:

```
PATCH /v1/catalog/default 200 OK
{"defaultRevision":"rev-2024-05-31","effectiveAt":"2024-06-17T12:03:21Z"}
```

Sahil Rao: verification: sample request now uses tokenizer=byte-level-bpe, tokenization errors gone on test traces.

deploy-bot: catalog.defaultRevision updated -> rev-2024-05-31. Change propagated to control-plane in ~12s.

Jordan Patel: traffic/err rates improving — ACME errors dropped from 11% -> 0.8% over last 3m. Latency is back to baseline.

Emma Chen: great. I'm setting incident severity to SEV2 (production impact but mitigated). Creating ticket/incidents entry and PR for stricter validation before catalog promotion (tokenizer compatibility check).

Emma Chen: quick notes for handoff: rollback done, routing override applied by Marta, monitoring in green. I'll hand to Marta for postmortem and long-term fixes. @Marta Gomez can you take postmortem and follow up with product on gating?

Marta Gomez: taking postmortem. I'll open PM/PR and add regression test for tokenizer field + gate promotion on compat. Also will schedule a brief blameless review.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-4521 acknowledged by Emma Chen. Escalation stopped.

deploy-bot: routing override removed after verification; final routing now matches catalog default (rev-2024-05-31).

Emma Chen: closing pager after 20m watch. Will follow up with postmortem doc and action items. Thanks everyone for the quick help :thumbsup:

Jordan Patel: thanks all — please ping customers ACME + BetaCorp about resolution (CS/AM loop).

Sahil Rao: noted. I'll attach logs + verification traces to the incident ticket.

Marta Gomez: will own customer comms with support. Adding timeline and root cause hypotheses to the postmortem.
